mockOnModuleNamespace.text: This mocks a member of an `import * as` namespace with node:test. An ES module namespace is sealed: its properties cannot be redefined, so the mock throws `Cannot redefine property` every time and the test never runs its body. Mock the object the module really exports instead: for a node builtin, the CommonJS exports reached through `createRequire(import.meta.url)`, followed by `syncBuiltinESMExports()` so the namespace's live binding sees the mock.
